speaker: Doctor
text:
I see you are pregnant and experiencing fever, headache, anorexia, fatigue, and malaise. To better understand your condition, have you noticed any specific skin rash or sensitivity to light?

Also, please tell me if you have had any contact with someone who recently had a fever or illness in the last week.

text: 22-year-old female at 30 weeks gestation. The patient presents with a sudden onset of fever, headache, anorexia, fatigue, and malaise. She reports the consumption of ice cream 3 days prior to the onset of symptoms.
